scope: Current W01a M10_FS020, 80 m domain; original M09 calm cohort superseded by explicit user selection.
objective: Find the least costly mesh with controlled force and wave error. Finer levels are references for later coarsening.
existing_W01a_GPU_run: Read completed checkpoint files only; do not stop, modify or use its GPU for mesh tests.
source_checkpoint: Completed W01a inlet-wave checkpoint after the full-height ramp; source copied and hashes verified.

wave.initialization: Reuse actual inlet-generated W01a fields and fixed source wave profiles; no global reinitialization.

CFL.note: Project screening for implicit URANS/VOF, not a universal explicit CFL stability rule. Same dt on all meshes; halve after failed pilots; always test dt/2.

wall_yplus.local_exceedances: Allowed by explicit user instruction; preserve spatial diagnostics and assess convergence.

GCI.oscillatory_or_unresolved: Withhold standard monotone GCI; do not force an estimate.
GCI.acceptance: Quantity-specific; controls and cycle drift must be small relative to spatial differences. Not experimental or 3D/spanwise validation.

outputs: Audit JSONs, simulation files, histories and GCI data only; no new report.
